append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-26: the nav list and the mobile bar use spacing tokens (h-4.25, h-5.5, h-6, h-6.5, translate-y-4.5), 26 sites. The tab-bar icon pin in components/layout/header-fit.test.ts was rewritten at Daniel's request ("rewrite the tab bar icon pin", 2026-10-26) to match h-5.5 w-5.5.
